verdict.rationale: Retell's Conductor assistant lets users build/edit agents, run tests, inspect calls, and build dashboards entirely via plain-language requests with review-before-apply, and the quick-start flow even offers 'Generate from prompt' to draft an agent from a plain-English description — directly matching natural-language operation of the product. missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration of Conductor's natural-language accuracy or reliability (only first-party docs exist).
